description_en: Queries the details of a serverless cluster by calling DescribeServerlessCluster
kebab_example: aliyun hbase describe-serverless-cluster --zone-id sdh0b7f4k5f0000 --cluster-id hb-bp16f1441y6p20000 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeServerlessCluster

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html operation to query the zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属可用区ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html接口获取
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID, which is a unique identifier generated by the system. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID，系统生成的唯一标识码。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144595.html接口获取
parameters.name: cluster_id

AutoRenew.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled. Valid values:
true: Auto-renewal is enabled.
false: Auto-renewal is not enabled
AutoRenew.description_zh:
是否续费：
true：续费。
false：不续费

ClusterType.description_en:
The cluster type. Valid values:
Cluster: Cluster Edition.
Single: single-node
ClusterType.description_zh:
集群类型。
Cluster：集群版。
Single：单节点

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was created

DiskSize.description_en: The disk size of the node. Unit: GB

HaType.description_en:
Indicates whether high availability (HA) is enabled. Valid values:
true: HA is enabled.
false: HA is not enabled
HaType.description_zh:
是否高可用：
true：高可用。
false：非高可用

HasUser.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster has users. Valid values:
true: The cluster has users.
false: The cluster does not have users
HasUser.description_zh:
是否有用户。
true：有用户。
false：无用户

IsDeletionProtection.description_en: Indicates whether deletion protection is enabled

LockMode.description_en:
The lock type of the cluster.
This parameter does not return a value
LockMode.description_zh:
集群锁定类型。
该参数无返回值

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型：
Prepaid：预付费。
Postpaid：后付费

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the resource belongs

Status.description_en:
The current status. Valid values:
CREATING: being created.
ACTIVATION: running.
DELETING: being deleted.
RESTARTING: being restarted
Status.description_zh:
当前状态：
CREATING：创建中。
ACTIVATION：运行中
DELETING：删除中。
RESTARTING：重启中

UpdateStatus.description_en:
The minor version upgrade status. Valid values:
YES: An upgrade is available.
NO: No upgrade is available.
PENDING: An upgrade is in progress
UpdateStatus.description_zh:
小版本升级的状态：
YES：可以升级。
NO：不可以升级。
PENDING：升级中

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the instance belongs

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the instance
